STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray meal: mushrooms and fried eggs, buttered/dry toast, strawberries, yogurt, and orange juice.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The main plate is a white paper plate, roughly 20 cm diameter (side plate). Area = 3.14 x (10)^2 = 314 cm^2. The strawberry bowl (~12 cm) and toast plate (~15 cm) are separate vessels. I'll estimate the meal on the main plate plus its companion items, using the same scale for the bowl and toast plate.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Sautéed mushrooms
- Fried eggs (2)
- Toast (3 slices, two lightly toasted)
- Strawberries (cut)
- Yogurt (small cup, ~125 g)
- Orange juice (~200 ml glass)

STEP 4 - Area (main plate, 314 cm^2):
- Mushrooms: ~20% = 63 cm^2 x 1.2 cm = 75 ml x 0.6 = 45 g x 22 kcal/100g = 10 kcal (mushrooms are sliced/cooked; use 0.6 g/ml for loose pieces)
- Fried eggs: ~25% = 79 cm^2 x 1.0 cm = 79 ml x 0.95 = 75 g x 196 kcal/100g = 147 kcal

Toast plate (~15 cm, area ~177 cm^2):
- Toast: ~45% = 80 cm^2 x 1.5 cm (stacked) = 120 ml x 0.3 (bread) = 36 g x 265 kcal/100g = 95 kcal. The slices are stacked, so bread-like density is closer to the loaf value; I use 0.3 as a conservative bulk figure for the stacked, airy slices.

Strawberry bowl (~12 cm, area ~113 cm^2):
- Strawberries: ~60% covered = 68 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 170 ml x 0.6 = 102 g x 32 kcal/100g = 33 kcal

Yogurt cup: ~125 g x 60 kcal/100g = 75 kcal (labelled-style estimate, Greek-style yogurt, 125 g)
Orange juice: ~200 ml x 45 kcal/100g (density 1.0) = 200 g x 45 = 90 kcal

STEP 5-7 Totals are summed below.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Eggs ~75 g, toast ~36 g, mushrooms ~45 g, strawberries ~100 g, yogurt ~125 g, juice ~200 g. Total food ~380 g (plus juice ~200 g). Energy ~450 kcal food plus juice 90 kcal, about 540 kcal. This is plausible for a full breakfast tray.

Estimated total: ~580 g (including juice), ~540 kcal.
